releaseStatus.reason: No C6 or C7 model has completed the full approval workflow. The models array must remain empty until at least one model entry passes FR-LIC-004 (C6 Curated Base Weight) or FR-LIC-014 (C7 Annotation Assist Model) review and is recorded in docs/model-governance/ with all required evidence and approver sign-off. Release gates G-DEP-07 (C6) and G-DEP-08 (C7) both fail with zero approved models (docs/dependency-policy.md §12). Approval requires completion of SPI-11 or SPI-12 for C6 base weights, or SPI-13 or SPI-14 for C7 assist checkpoints (docs/implementation-plan.md Phase C).
